'''mrwaltdog Invasion/In Complete Control''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 30 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion mrwaltdog DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I always thought that an invasion deck would be intersting to make and I finally got the cards needed to make one. What do you guys think?

== Strategy ==

Basically you get out the naboo sites expecially the throne  room and get a nemoidian there to flip as soon as you can. It would be prefered to put Rune Haako at the throne room to get a forec drain bonus and his ability to increae attrition. Put Nute at the Bridge so your droids get an extra power. Also get Naboo Occupation out asap with enough droids so you can eliminate the fore light side generates at all naboo sites you control with a battle droid on their turn. And of course as usual drain from the sites and system. Also make sure you have at least two battle droids of different names at the sites so you an get two battle destiny. The sharships are there to protect the flagship. Put the Battle droid pilots on the battle ships and forfiet them if you need to. THen redeploy them next turn. Delopy the blaster rifles to the Infantry droids to make opponent lose 1 when you shoot them. Get a six on Colo Claw fish to be able to easily take out almost anything. Use the starship weapons to take out ships and if you have the Admiral Order out then they lose two force.  Use Drop Your Weapons to eliminate any pesky weapons opponent may have there. also The Activate the droids comes in hand to activate or retreive force. Also be sure to get a MTT on the table to reduce the cost to pull a droid off Droid Rack to 1 from 2.

Thankx in advance for any comments all are appriciated.
